newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Filipinos jailed in Bangladesh for smuggling gold.
newsitem.headline: Filipinos jailed in Bangladesh for smuggling gold.

text.p: Two Filipino sailors have been sentenced to jail in Bangladesh for smuggling gold into the country four years ago, court officials said on Wednesday.
Security officers at Chittagong port caught Fredo Rossel and an accomplice with 17.46 kg (38 lb) in gold bars strapped to their bodies on August, 1993, the officials said.
Fredo was sentenced on Tuesday to 14 years in jail and the accomplice 10 years. They were also fined 10,000 taka ($230) each, the officials said.
At current market prices the gold would be worth about $207,000.
